# tshapedconsultant — Andrés Lage Freire

> AI Governance Engineering: the design and implementation of controls, accountability and evidence across the AI lifecycle.

Andrés Lage Freire is a Responsible AI Architect. Based in Madrid · Working remotely across EMEA. He helps CTOs, Heads of AI and Risk/Compliance leaders in banking, insurance and energy turn AI risk, regulatory obligations and accountability requirements into executable controls, lifecycle gates and verifiable evidence.

This site was designed and built by Andrés with AI-assisted coding, treating accessibility, privacy, performance and auditability as first-class constraints.

Typical work: EU AI Act readiness, ISO/IEC 42001, and governance of RAG systems and agents.

The practice argument is that probabilistic models require deterministic governance — independent runtime limits on what a system may access, decide and execute, with evidence generated at the control boundary.
